h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Hubli–Dharwad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Hubli–Dharwad

items.pText: Hubli and Dharwad are twin cities in north Karnataka, run by one municipal corporation but quite different in character. Hubli is the commercial and railway centre, while Dharwad is known for its university, colleges and schools with large grounds. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to both from our factory in Vasai, about 500 km away, delivered by road.

On a big school or college campus, the hard question is often where the play area should go. A ground that hosts cricket, football and sports day needs a play zone that stays out of the way of balls, runners and crowds. We look at your campus plan and suggest a corner that is safe from stray balls, easy to supervise and close to the junior classrooms. The climate here is milder than much of north Karnataka, with a good monsoon from June.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Placing a play area on a campus with sports fields

c: Keep the play zone well clear of the boundary of any cricket or football field, or screen it with a fence or a row of trees. Avoid the edge of the running track, where crowds gather on sports day. A spot near the primary block lets teachers bring classes out quickly and watch them from a verandah. Lay a firm path to the play area so children do not cross a muddy ground after rain.

items.q: Where should a school put its playground on a large campus?
items.a: Away from cricket and football fields and the running track, and close to the junior classrooms. We review your campus plan and suggest a spot that teachers can supervise easily.

items.q: Do you supply both Hubli and Dharwad?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to sites in both cities by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in Karnataka.

items.q: Can colleges order outdoor gym equipment as well?
items.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range covers outdoor gym machines for students and staff. We can plan the gym and the children's play area on the same layout drawing if you need both.
